observedFacts: The 15 August published witness reports two distinct storify.source.start executions reaching succeeded; the second run cannot reuse the first run's success.
The current 30 October integration scenario declares executable, while Book coverage labels this same scenario live-accepted. This is status drift, not sufficient current acceptance proof.
The original private Store exports and window-ID/AX witness bundle were not independently re-read in this pilot.

candidate.lesson: A reusable procedure derived from a scenario with repeated operations must point to fresh execution identities and distinct terminal evidence for each required run. Historical witnesses cannot override current scenario coverage disagreement.
candidate.novelty: The general skill-learning proposal procedure does not yet require execution-freshness evidence when repeated success is used to justify transferability.
candidate.trigger: An agent proposes procedural learning from a repeated scenario step, scenario cohort or restart/resume experiment.
prerequisites: The exact scenario contract, coverage record, witness revision and evidence authority have been reconciled.
Independent terminal Store receipt identities from the repeated executions are available for review before stronger proof claims.
steps: Inspect current scenario status and its published coverage without strengthening either status from prose.
Identify every repeated operation and its declared newExecution or replay semantics; require distinct terminal receipt identity where the contract requires fresh execution.
Compare independent Store, AX and window-ID proof against the same bound scenario source and process identity.
If evidence and status disagree, retain a non-admitted learning proposal and name the exact missing witnesses rather than inventing success.
failureBoundaries: Reusing the first execution's success for a second step must fail.
An older published success cannot silently promote a current executable scenario to live-accepted.
A proposal cannot introduce a new runtime Kit identity or trigger account/OpenAI distribution.
transferTests: A cohort with two required new executions and the same execution ID fails freshness validation.
A scenario with source status executable and Book coverage live-accepted remains status-drift even when an older accepted witness exists.
An independently verified two-run example with different Store receipts still requires separate owner review before any skill promotion.
